description: GET /api/v1/catalog/miners — public ASIC catalog (specs only, no user profitability). Includes Kadena/KDA, NexaPow/NEXA, XPHash/XP, zkSNARK/ALEO, Blake3/ALPH, and SHA-256 QUAI-capable SKUs under 5000 W. Goldshell HS-Lite is one row (`hs-lite`) with dual modes (Blake2B-SHA3/HNS and Blake2B SC/BTCB2). No API key required.
name: list_catalog_miners
title: List catalog miners
